# Zigzag CP perf: plain (contiguous) vs zzcp, inter-only and inter+intra
# GB200 x4 (SM100), CP4, batch=1, h_qk=16 h_v=16, one doc spanning all cards
# ms = worst-rank median; ratio zz/pl > 1 means zzcp slower. Generated by benchmark/bench_zigzag_cp.py
# NOTE: inter-only zzcp looks ~1.9x faster only because plain-inter runs ONE long
#       T/4 recurrent scan while zzcp hands each rank 2 shorter T/8 segments (more
#       CTAs, shorter critical path) -- an accidental intra-like win. The production
#       baseline is inter+intra (dual), where zzcp costs 11-82% overhead, shrinking
#       to ~1.11x at 1M (full all-gather + 2x segments + conservative full warmup).

>>> INFER (fwd)  h_qk=16 h_v=16 CP4 bs=1  (ms = worst rank; ratio = zzcp/plain, >1 = zzcp slower)
   seqlen | inter plain  inter zzcp  zz/pl |  dual plain   dual zzcp  zz/pl
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32768 |     0.85     1.17  1.39x |     1.11     1.02  0.91x
    65536 |     1.41     1.27  0.90x |     0.87     2.47  2.85x
   131072 |     2.67     1.51  0.57x |     1.29     1.99  1.54x
   262144 |     5.24     2.86  0.55x |     1.34     2.40  1.79x
   524288 |    10.34     5.52  0.53x |     1.74     2.27  1.30x
  1048576 |    20.61    10.88  0.53x |     3.28     3.75  1.14x

>>> TRAIN (fwd+bwd)  h_qk=16 h_v=16 CP4 bs=1  (ms = worst rank; ratio = zzcp/plain, >1 = zzcp slower)
   seqlen | inter plain  inter zzcp  zz/pl |  dual plain   dual zzcp  zz/pl
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32768 |     2.56     2.48  0.97x |     2.19     2.50  1.14x
    65536 |     4.90     2.86  0.58x |     2.09     3.80  1.82x
   131072 |     9.52     5.26  0.55x |     2.16     3.83  1.77x
   262144 |    18.85    10.13  0.54x |     3.20     4.86  1.52x
   524288 |    37.36    19.81  0.53x |     5.96     7.18  1.20x
  1048576 |    74.55    39.24  0.53x |    11.37    12.61  1.11x
